notes.title: Version 2.0
notes.content: [p]so it's been a little while since the last update... so today I bring you Version 2.0 of Meteorites 3D![/p][p][/p][h2]What's New?[/h2][list][*][p]Added a combo meter! now you can grow a multiplier for your points so long as you can destroy targets in quick succession, just be careful when trying to build up those combos![/p][/*][*][p]With the introduction of combos I've add a highest combo leaderboard, separate from the highest score, you can view it from the main menu using the button on screen, try and get to the top of both leaderboards![/p][/*][*][p]Added a "How To Play" on the main menu for those who might be a little confused on how the game works, the gameplay loop may understandably come across as confusing to some.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a pause menu, pressing the pause button on your controller or "esc" will pause the game, where you can unpause, restart the game or go back to the main menu (now replacing the annoying "pressing esc will take you back to the main menu".[/p][/*][*][p]When in game holding down the X button on your keyboard will take you back to the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Digi Games Intro.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]What's Changed?[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Meteorites no longer track you like heat seeking missiles, instead they'll now throw themselves at you at full speed then start to drift off, clumping together making for an easy combo target, just beware of your surroundings.[/p][/*][*][p]Saucers have been slowed down a bit as they were previously a little too fast, also made their precision on their shots a little more accurate, faster and larger.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed "boosting" as in play testing I've seen players boosting 24/7, so having a boost button makes no sense to have.[/p][/*][*][p]Bullets are ever so slightly larger and faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the delay before being able to fire again.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Patches and Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Updated the "crosshair"'s so they're not as blurry and scuffed anymore.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the timer so it only counts in seconds, for those players that go over 1 hour.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused meteorites to stop spawning after a certain period of time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented achievements from being achieved.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug that caused your points not to save onto the leaderboard.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]What's Next For The Game?[/h1][p]Well I'll have to be brutally honest, this is my last planned update for the game, depending on bug reports there may be an update or a patch here and there, but this is the final planned update, I wanted to get out a final update addressing a lot of issues that I've seen players come across, before moving onto new projects and games I want to work on and create! [/p][p]This game was made using Unreal Engine and me giving a go at C++, which was... something, I like unreal but it definitely has it's downsides, so I want to try out making some games on other engines (such as godot!) ontop of that, I'm juggling an editing job and trying to grow a YouTube channel, there's plenty of work for me to do, and maintaining Meteorites 3D is not really top of that list. [/p][p]So I apologise if the news upsets you (holy loyal fan lol) but this will be the last update for Meteorites 3D.[/p][p]Keep an eye out for the next game I post! (probably in the next 200 years) and thank you![/p]

notes.title: It's finally here!
notes.content:
Hiya everyone!

So it's been a little while since you've heard from me, apologies on that I've been very busy (both irl and busy fixing some of the issues with the game)

It is my pleasure to finally say that I've added Controller Support! A feature I've wanted in the game since day one but couldn't due to some technical difficulties! (turns out steam does not like controllers a lot lol)

along with your favourite modern arcade joysticks I've fixed up some of the common issues I've notice people come across by reading the community posts and listening to feedback.

The changes are as follows:

[list]
[*] Added Controller Support

[*] Prevent asteroids from launching at you if they are right next to you, giving you more breathing space

[*] Any asteroids that get destroyed close to you don't get launched as easily

[*] Asteroids are less like heat seeking missiles and now more like less accurate rocket launchers

[*] Achievements that were not unlocking previously should now unlock correctly
[/list]

- Every 10,000 points should add an extra life correctly now (before getting to scores such as 30,000, 40,000, etc would not add a life as intended)

Hopefully now climbing up the leaderboard should be an easier feat, I'd personally love to try and see someone reach 1,000,000 😏 can you?

More features I plan are coming at some point I promise! I really want to mould my first game release into something amazing for everyone new and old, they will just take time (due to being in uni lol) so stay tuned.

Finally, if you'd like to give any feedback or want to join in on the community feel free to join the discord server games hub
https://discord.gg/s3wQHzNQqJ
We're small at the moment but in due time we can grow by building the Meteorites 3D Community!

[b]Thank you all for joining me on my game dev venture![/b]

notes.title: Notice about Controller Support
notes.content:
Heya everyone,
I'm sorry to make this announcement but controller support will not be available until a future update, this is not because I'm lazy and can't be asked to add it but this is because my controller for testing has broken and I currently don't have the funds to buy a new one to test with, so controller support will not be available until I can get a new one and add it in a future patch.

Hopefully this should not be too far into the future but I thought I'd quickly let you all know ahead of time so you don't plug in a controller and get mad at me for not making controller work, I you all to feel smooth controls when using a controller with this game, and that's not something I can deliver with a broken controller,
thank you for understanding, and thank you everyone for the continued support on the game!

notes.title: Meteorites Release Date Change
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone!
[/h1]
So to quickly clear up any confusion, the release that was mentioned in the gameplay trailer, found here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZCltK9ohjGw
States that the game was planned to be released sometime during August (as of writing this, this month)

I'm afraid that's changed now due to some circumstances that have happened in my life which reduced my time to work on the game. To make it a quick story, this game is only a side project of mine and I still have a job that I need to attend to and in choosing the release date I was too ambitious. And so the game is not yet ready for release, so the new planned release date is now going to be [b]16th December[/b] This should give me enough time to work out the kinks of the game and balance my life at the same time. If I can get those sorted sooner, I may pull the date forward so I won't keep everyone waiting for too long!

Thank you everyone for waiting so patiently for this game.

Edit: Due to Steamworks Devs not being available on the 17th as it's a weekend the release date was reduced to the 16th instead!
